title: Detection of  L- and E-selectin ligand by ligand blotting using L- and E-selectin-IgM chimeric proteins
protocol: Collect culture supernatant two to three days post-transfection.
Concentrate the medium using Centriprep YM-30 or YM-100 for 10 to 50 fold.
Perform SDS polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis of desired materials and transfer proteins onto Immobilon-P by standard procedure.
Block the blot with 10 mg/ml bovine serum albumin in washing buffer for 30 min.
Incubate the filter with concentrated culture supernatant containing E/L-selectin-IgM without dilution for 1 hr at 4°C.
Wash the blot three times with washing buffer, each wash lasting 20 min.
Incubate the blot with 10,000 x diluted HRP-anti-human IgM for 1 hr at 4°C.
Wash the blot as in blocking step (30 min with bovine serum albumin).
